scope: Owned semantic-dispatch review accompanying syntax/import audit; not independent human model-quality or deployment acceptance.

entries.assessment: All runtime output dispatch is by Binding/Projection/Render capability and TypeSpec. Legacy templates are read-only migration inputs. No label, product, equipment code or filename is used to select report facts.
Exact source-record IDs and field predicates; business records are data resources. Names/codes do not derive class, material or workshop.

Retained synthetic schedule generator called only by /api/mock-sources. Its deliberate fixture schedules are source data, not report evidence; report use requires explicit candidate validation, review and commit.
Structured adapters use explicit field maps. doc_repo does not call a model to invent missing mapped values. Legacy unverified candidates cannot enter published snapshots.
Canonical IR sections and stable IDs are preserved. Model suggestions have no authority to publish inputs, claims or facts; missing IR produces diagnostics.
Retained read-only V1 migration utility, with exact schema paths. It does not generate report facts or publish templates.
Retained V1 authoring utility without production callers; creates draft source declarations only. V1 runtime and publication are gated by migration.
Non-risk rule seeds remain explicit pre-existing domain definitions. R-RA1–5 are retired from seed/execution and preserved in migration ledgers; published legacy rows cannot be updated/deleted.

Existing adapter entity types and change-event keys are explicit upstream record contracts; list filtering is presentation only. Report rendering does not call these adapters, search their labels, or accept their raw records as published assertions.

Authoring uses stable references and exact ontology menus. OutputPreview consumes saved OutputAST; signature envelopes have independent identities. No report fact reconstruction occurs in the browser.
